name: Ouminato Yuuma
source: The protagonist. A baby-faced guy who has a kind personality. His biggest dream is becoming a best-selling light novel writer, however he has yet to pass the first qualification rounds at writing contests. At the academy, he often does odd jobs for both the student council and the second literature club, which he was forced into joining by [url=/c44182]Yuzuna[/url]. After the grimoire ends up in his hands, he ends up in various lewd scenarios with his schoolmates.
